title: feat(spec)!: PROTOCOL_VERSION 18 → 19, and every current-protocol handshake reads '^19'
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ
Fixes #37229
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none in this PR — the three `skills/**` files that declare `'^18'` (`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`, `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json`, `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md`) move in the sibling Tier H PR #37298 (PR 2 of #37229), which lands with this one or right after it.

## 维护者速读

- 协议版本从 18 升到 19:仓库里每个示例应用、连接器应用和文档示例都改为声明 19,新建项目模板在出预发布版时自动改成 19;只有装 19 预发布版的人会碰到。
- 属于「19.0.0 大版本」路线(你选的方案「A」第 2 项);它解开 19.0.0-next 的版本 PR:出版本的流水线不接受顺手改协议版本,所以由这一单先改好。
- 装了 19 预发布版、但应用仍声明 18 的人,启动时会被拒绝并提示改成 19(有一条命令可自动改);18.x 正式版用户不受影响;撤回即还原本单。
- 要你做的:「进入预发布模式」那一单已合并;本单是大版本变更,请你亲自把关合并(另一单 #37298 改三个技能文件,跟它一起或紧随其后合并)。

## What changes

On the shape of the v18 move (#22215, commit `4e9fe9f`), minus `skills/**`.

- **`packages/spec/src/kernel/protocol-version.ts`:** `PROTOCOL_VERSION = '19.0.0'`. The docblock names protocol 19 as the pre-mode lockstep exception (ruling records 6049734955 and 7153441862).
- **Handshakes:** 84 sites in 66 files move `engines.protocol` from `'^18'` to `'^19'`. Each is a manifest that stands for "an app on the current protocol", and none of them asserts on the range.

| Directory | Files | Sites |
|---|---|---|
| `examples/` (crm, showcase, todo, multi-package ×2) | 5 | 5 |
| `packages/apps/connector-{docusign,github,stripe}` | 3 | 3 |
| `packages/cli` (tests) | 40 | 56 |
| `packages/qa` (7 dogfood tests, the sql-perf bench app, the scenarios exporter test) | 9 | 9 |
| `packages/lint`, `packages/spec`, `packages/metadata` (tests) | 4 | 5 |
| `packages/mcp/README.md` | 1 | 2 |
| `content/docs` (cli, your-first-project, upgrading) | 3 | 3 |
| `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json` | 1 | 1 |

- **`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json`:** one prose fact, "the stock showcase declares `'^18'`", now reads `'^19'`.
- **The protocol 19 migration step (ADR-0087).** `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template` opens `step19`, with no conversions yet. Its first semantic entry, `entries/semantic/19.protocol-18-range-refused.ts`, is the refusal this PR causes, with the prescription. The upgrade guide now generates three hop sections (17, 18, 19). See "Why a step-19 entry" below.
- **Two fixtures pay a dynamic load at module top** (`validate-flow-region-shape.test.ts`, `plugin-artifact-packages-attribution.test.ts`). `check:test-source-alias` judges every test file a diff edits, and both edits here are the range literal. The gate prescribes exactly these imports.
- **`.changeset/37229-protocol-19.md`:** `"@objectstack/spec": minor`, the two declaration lines, a BREAKING note with the FROM → TO and the command, and `registered protocol-18-range-refused`.
- **Carried from #37230's L1, now that it is on `main`:**
  - **N1 — DELIBERATE CORRECTION of an existing changeset.** `.changeset/37223-v19-line-opens.md` now reads: "The first change graded `major` is `@object-ui/i18n`'s retirement of the translation keys 18.6.0 shipped and no code reads any more; a second `major` in the same `fixed` group still gives one 19.0.0." It used to say "The first is …". This PR's protocol move, a breaking change graded `minor`, makes that untrue. No other sentence of that note moves.
  - **N3 — `ui/packages/i18n/scripts/released-keys-removed.mjs`** refuses an argument it does not know (exit 2, naming it), and prints the tag's commit: `^{commit}` peels the annotated tag. Measured: the tag `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` is a tag object `0dbef86ce3`, and the script now prints its commit `958ee03594`. The script is not in the package's `files[]`, so it publishes nothing and needs no changeset.

## Judgments: every `'^18'` left in place, with its reason

| Site | Reason |
|---|---|
| `skills/**` (3 files) | Governed Tier H; the sibling PR #37298. |
| `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/objectstack.config.ts:38` | The version pass stamps it with the template's `@objectstack/*` versions, and `template-consistency.test.ts` holds it equal to the scaffolder major (create-objectstack is 18.6.0). Measured: moved to `'^19'` now, that test goes red; the version-pass rehearsal below stamps it `'^19'`. Same judgment as #22215. |
| `packages/cli/src/utils/protocol-version-gap.test.ts:82` | Paired with an explicit installed `'17.2.0'`: "a newer major is silent". The subject is the pairing, not the current protocol. |
| `packages/metadata-core/src/artifact-forward-conversion*.test.ts`, `protocol-handshake.test.ts` | The subject is the artifact's floor against an injected runtime label (the v18 prerelease major-step window), or a range/major pair. No handshake against `PROTOCOL_VERSION` runs. |
| `packages/metadata/src/plugin-artifact-forward-conversion-{major-step,package-body}.test.ts` | The same age subject at the metadata door, which runs no handshake. |
| `content/docs/releases/**`, `docs/adr/**`, `**/CHANGELOG.md`, `.github/workflows/release.yml` (comment), script comments | Release-owned, governed or historical prose. |
| `ui/**` tests, `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-ensure-customization.test.ts`, `scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs` | Not a protocol handshake (`requiredRange` of a later refusal, a package-dependency range, a React peer range). |

Moved to `'>=18.0.0'` (5 sites, commit `e05fdf6f`): `packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack-option-b-forward-conversion.test.ts`. It boots through the load seam, which refuses `'^18'` at protocol 19. Measured: `ProtocolIncompatibleError: package 'com.test.ob.core' targets protocol ^18 … Run: objectstack migrate meta --from 18`, 3 cases. Its subject is the conversion window, which opens on the floor. `'>=18.0.0'` keeps the floor (18.0.0, as `parseRangeFloor` reads `^18`) and admits 19. This is the same move as #22215's two runtime fixtures (`>=17.1.0`).

## Why a step-19 entry (the ADR-0087 disposition)

`Metadata-protocol:` is judged from content. A 19 runtime refuses an authored value, `engines.protocol: '^18'`, that 18 admitted. That is `narrowed`, and the `Clause-②` arm is `narrowing`, as in #22215. On a declared `narrowed`, `check:adr-0087-registration` refuses `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` outright and asks for a registered entry. Measured: "`not-required (no-migration-prescription)` is refused on a changeset that declares `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` … fix: register an entry under packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/". No entry at the merge base covers the refusal, so this PR opens step 19 with one entry, and the upgrade guide carries the prescription.

## Acceptance notes

- **Docs versus npm `latest`.** The three docs pages show `'^19'`, as in #22215. npm `latest` stays 18.6.0 until 19.0 GA, and an 18.x runtime refuses `'^19'`. The changeset says to move the range together with the `@objectstack/*` versions.
- **Size.** 74 files, +210 / −95 against `main`, under the 3,000-line threshold.
- **Out of this PR, found by the version-pass rehearsal.** On the post-version tree, `check:release-notes` is red: `@objectstack/spec` ships 19.x and there is no curated `content/docs/releases/v19` page. It is red on the control leg too (main + #37230, without this PR), so #37230's `major` causes it, not this PR. Release pages are release-owned, so this PR does not write one. Until one exists, the version-PR lane still refuses the 19.0.0-next refresh, on that gate alone.
- **#37287 and step 19.** #37287 registers a new retirement under step 18. Once protocol 19 is on `main`, `os migrate meta --from 18` replays only step 19, so a retirement that ships on the v19 line and is filed under step 18 is not listed to an 18 → 19 upgrader. Noted for that PR's seat; not filed.
- **The dev's open questions, as built (seat reading at L1):**
  - The declaration is `yes (narrowing)` + `narrowed` with a step-19 entry, rather than `semantic`.
  - The blank template stays `'^18'`, and the version pass stamps it.
  - The metadata and metadata-core floor-subject sites are kept. The option-B runtime file moves to `'>=18.0.0'`.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main` prints `✓ Protocol lockstep: PROTOCOL_VERSION major 19, @objectstack/spec@18.6.0 — the one exception, evidenced: pre mode (tag next) and a pending major for @objectstack/spec (.changeset/37223-v19-line-opens.md).` and exits 0.

Read first:
1. `.changeset/37229-protocol-19.md` and `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/19.protocol-18-range-refused.ts`: what an upgrading author is told.
2. `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template`, the new `step19`: the ledger's protocol 19 step opens here.
3. The Judgments table: every `'^18'` left in place.

<details><summary>Readings (the dev's, on 9da4c1d4 plus the fixture fix, through the verify lock)</summary>

- **Handshake**, from the built `@objectstack/metadata-core` on protocol 19: `'^18'` → `incompatible OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE … Run: objectstack migrate meta --from 18`; `'^19'` → `ok`.
- **Prescription**, with the built CLI on a `'^18'` copy of `examples/app-todo`: `os migrate meta --from 18` lists the step-19 entry, and `--write` rewrites the range to `'^19'`.
- **Template control leg:** moving the blank template to `'^19'` now turns `template-consistency.test.ts` red (`expected 19 to be 18`).
- **`release.yml` version-pass rehearsal.** The `version-pr` Render and Validate blocks were extracted verbatim and run in a throwaway clone:
  - Results: `PROTOCOL_VERSION already 19.0.0`; the template is stamped `'^19'`; unvalidated surfaces 0; 14 of 15 content gates green; `check:release-notes` red.
  - Control (main + #37230 without this PR): `protocol-version.ts` is unvalidated, with the same release-notes red.
- **Tests:**
  - dogfood full battery: Test Files 487 passed | 3 skipped (490), Tests 4128 passed | 68 skipped (4196), VERDICT command-exit 0.
  - cli: 677 files, 8441 tests passed.
  - runtime: 647 files, 11978 passed | 25 skipped. The option-B file fails 3 cases at 9da4c1d4 and passes 6/6 at e05fdf6f.
  - metadata, metadata-core, lint, mcp, the spec kernel/migrations/conversions suites, create-objectstack, scenarios and the example tests: all green.
  - `validate` exits 0 for 4 examples and 3 connector apps.
- **Guards:**
  - `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main` exits 0.
  - `check:adr-0087-registration` exits 0 with `registered protocol-18-range-refused`. Control: `no-migration-prescription` exits 1.
  - `check:upgrade-guide`: `protocol 19.0.0, 3 major hop section(s)`.
  - `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 124 families: 120 exit 0, and 4 were NOT MEASURED because of prerequisite refusals (teardown-shape self-test, skill-examples, dual-build-cjs-loads, type-check-debt). CI runs those four.

</details>

## Provenance

Opened by seat repo:objectstack#4 on the maintainer's authorization in the seat session (「#37229 的两个 PR 开 PR 时被拦了：放行」). The dev session (`session_01QSeKYnLptCbfzwtkTrDG3j`, zone a4-S) had three writes refused by its permission check, and none was retried: its relay `pr_create`, the hand-off of the payload to the seat, and the push of the runtime fixture fix. The seat read the prepared body from that session's final message. The fixture fix was then re-applied and pushed as `e05fdf6f` (fast-forward, five sites in one test file) by a seat-dispatched dev, on the maintainer's authorization 「#37229 夹具修复推送放行」. Branch `claude/issue-37229-protocol-version-19` @ `e05fdf6f`.
